facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The emperor wore nothing. Everyone pretended. They were all afraid. No one spoke up.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The swindlers pretended to dress the emperor in new clothes. The emperor stood in front of the mirror wearing nothing. All the ministers praised the beautiful invisible cloth. No one spoke up because they were afraid of looking foolish. Everyone kept the secret and told the same lie. The emperor decided to parade through the town.
facts.Word cards: tricked = 속였다 / two men = 두 남자 / magic = 마법의 / swindlers = 사기꾼
